statement_scope: Whole original Problem4, counted once: for a regular integer-side hexagon, determine lozenge tilings after removing one upward and one downward innermost unit triangle, including BOTH geometrically distinct configurations, opposite triangles sharing only the center vertex and adjacent triangles sharing an edge.
